title: State Complexity of Exact Selective Randomization Replay in Posterior-Winner SMART Designs
banked_reason: Conditional on proof, the construction establishes a sharp fact about a newly designed exact-kernel family, but not a field-level consequence for a deployed SMART or an explicitly defined broad class; this supports letter-tier theory rather than the required field tier.
gap_reasons: Conditional on proof, the construction establishes a sharp fact about a newly designed exact-kernel family, but not a field-level consequence for a deployed SMART or an explicitly defined broad class; this supports letter-tier theory rather than the required field tier.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery first developed completion-invariant selected weights and compact replay certificates, then pivoted to a residual-law lower bound for a Norwood-et-al.-inspired exact posterior kernel. Seven proposal versions repaired bridge semantics, attribution, positivity, encoding, pilot conditioning, and the exact audit-state decoder without leaving structural or soundness flags. The field claim nevertheless collapsed because the surviving theorem applies to a purpose-built kernel; a re-raise must add either a protocol-faithful deployed-kernel embedding or a genuinely non-tautological broad-class transfer theorem.
tldr: Can an exact selected replay law be identified while winner/top-two logging remains exponentially inadequate? The proposal defines an \(O(k\log k)\)-encoded Norwood-et-al.-inspired exact-kernel SMART specialization: it retains the published beta-posterior and posterior-optimality architecture but replaces the paper's finite-M allocation by a new exact posterior-winner kernel with floor \(1/(4k)\). It seeks a \(2^{k-1}\) deterministic full-mark bridge lower bound, a matching exactly \(k-1\)-bit score-coordinate audit record, an h-coordinate logging/sharpening tradeoff, and an independent-pilot product-bridge mitigation under a separately defined pilot-conditional inference law; it makes no claim about the deployed I-SPY2.2 kernel.
gap: Selective-randomization theory gives validity and sufficient computability, exact response-adaptive work gives recursion after a state is supplied, and automata theory gives generic quotient machinery. The inspected SMART literature does not determine how much state an exact selected top-two replay bridge must retain. Norwood et al. use finite-M posterior-optimality approximations rather than the exact kernel defined here.
fill: Prove the exact-kernel specialization belongs to the primitive addressable-score class, establish its exponential deterministic bridge and bit lower bounds, show that the exactly k-1-bit coordinate vector and explicit beta-count decoder are matching, and give independent pilot freezing as a polynomial-state remedy for the separately defined pilot-conditional inference law under explicit hypotheses.
